result:
Both of my sub-tasks are merged and CD passed on each. I have no live check beyond CD saying it succeeded.

- **PLAT-104-1 (PR #1):** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. This library lives in the repo and is inlined into apps at build time, so there was no registry release or version bump to do. CD deploys nothing for a `libs/`-only change, so the merge shipped nothing by itself.
- **PLAT-104-2 (PR #2):** the billing bundle had to be rebuilt to pick up the new value. I bumped `apps/sub-route-billing` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 to make CD build and deploy it. I made no lockfile change because shared-contracts isn't a registry dependency.

**Coordination:** I never needed anything from dev-b, and I did none of their work on core-shell or reports. I merged PR #1 before opening PR #2 so their order was safe. The board was the only coordination channel, and I marked tasks 1 and 2 done there and ran `done` with my assumptions.

**Surprises:**
- CD only watches `apps/core-shell/` and `apps/sub-route-billing/`, so dev-b's two apps may also need a small change inside the app directory to deploy. The reports app isn't covered by CD at all, going by `docs/ci-cd.md`. That could need follow-up.
- My first `st pr open --help` call errored because the command has no help flag. The real `st pr open` call worked.
